what: Neon yellow (a few strokes white) hand-drawn lines over the photo — at each spot, three highlight strokes above the head, two cheek creases and a head outline are drawn with Lottie (.55,.06 → .36,1), then erased from the front after a pause. Each line has its own draw and erase window (drawn 0~1.4s, erased 1.6~3s) so they twinkle in turn, repeating every 5 seconds. Starts when it enters the 20% line at the bottom of the screen.

options.loop: If false, plays only once (hero photo that restarts from the beginning on each slide change), default repeats
options.when: With event, plays from the start every time fx:play is received (when tied to slider fx:change), default starts once when entering the screen
options.start: ScrollTrigger start position, default top bottom-=20%
options.width: Line width (in board size units), default 2
options.[data-fx-part=spot]: Where to draw the line — in style left and top (%), data-kind=effect (accent line) · wrinkle (creases) · halo (outline), data-dir=Accent line direction (deg), data-key=If surface, white line

note: The original Lottie JSON is not carried over — only the 30fps comp, 150 frames, stroke width 2, round caps, nine draw and erase windows and the curves were measured from the original, and the stroke shapes are our own. Once photos arrive, the spot positions will be fitted to people’s heads and cheeks.
